name: No Honor Among Thieves
summary: A former thief names Illari Duskfeather as the night elf who led the gang and left them behind. You are pointed toward her hideout on the coast of Arathi Highlands and her cache of stolen goods.

sections.title: A Gang Betrayed
sections.body: The marshal is on the gang's trail when Illari Duskfeather abandons them. A surviving thief believes they were used as patsies, though he cannot say why. He leaves the pursuit to anyone willing to follow it. Illari once spoke of a hideout on the coast of Arathi Highlands, where her stolen goods remain.

faq.answer: Illari Duskfeather is a night elf who led a gang of thieves. She gave them information on the camps and kept only some of their rarer finds.

faq.q: Why did Illari leave the gang?
faq.answer: The surviving thief does not know why Illari abandoned the gang when the marshal was on their trail.
Illari once mentioned a hideout on the coast of Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What does the gang want from Illari?
faq.answer: The gang's former member points you toward Illari's hideout and her cache of stolen goods.
Illari Duskfeather, a night elf, was the gang's boss.

angles.text: As a night elf, you learn that Illari Duskfeather led a gang of thieves and left them behind when the marshal pursued them.

attribution: In-game quest text: No Honor Among Thieves
